status: one-seed 31-output-token optimization and persistence diagnostic; not a headline result

gate_audit.task_optimization: fail: both conditions select the final or penultimate epoch with validation LM still improving; exact match is zero
gate_audit.causal_z_use: provisional pass at one seed: correct Z improves per-position satisfaction by .080 over shuffled Z
gate_audit.persistence: not evaluable: flat Z quartiles occur near floor, while the stronger direct condition declines by .280 from first to last quartile
gate_audit.decision: do not launch longer horizons; first converge the matched 31-token direct and Z conditions

interpretation: Direct canonical goal tokens outperform canonical late-layer Z by .467 absolute per-position satisfaction at the same scheduled horizon.
The Z condition uses example-specific goal information, but its .170 satisfaction is too close to floor for its small .019 drift to count as persistence.
The direct condition exposes genuine position-dependent degradation, falling from .764 in the first quartile to .483 in the last.
Because both validation losses are still improving at selection, this pilot diagnoses insufficient optimization rather than the horizon at which persistent Z becomes beneficial.
